instruction: Adjust the system volume so it reaches 90 percent of the maximum.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command:
pulseaudio --start
pactl list sinks | grep '^[[:space:]]Volume:' | head -n 1 | awk '{print $5}' | sed 's/%//g'

metadata.explanation: Task requires increasing system volume to 90%. Evaluator uses existing exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter to verify PulseAudio volume is set to 90%. This is a simple system setting change similar to the original task but with a different target volume.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically correct and can verify the instruction requirement
The vm_command_line getter correctly extracts the PulseAudio volume percentage using standard pactl commands
The command pipeline properly parses the volume output: starts PulseAudio, lists sinks, greps for Volume, extracts percentage value, and removes % sign
The exact_match metric correctly compares the result against the expected value '90\n'

llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor edge case: On systems with multiple audio sinks, 'head -n 1' assumes the first sink is the active one. Consider using 'pactl get-sink-volume @DEFAULT_SINK@' for more robust sink selection
